candidates.topic: Intercepted Signs — The Birth Chart Secret Most People Miss
candidates.teaser: There's a part of your birth chart that most astrologers barely mention — and it might explain why certain areas of your life feel completely blocked.
candidates.video_title: Intercepted Signs — The Hidden Part of Your Chart
candidates.video_description: Intercepted signs occur when a zodiac sign is fully enclosed within a house, with no house cusp touching it. In astrology, this is interpreted as a sign whose energy is harder to access — a hidden layer of the personality.
candidates.script: There's a zodiac sign hidden inside your birth chart that never touches a house cusp — it's called an intercepted sign, and most people don't even know theirs exists. In astrology, an intercepted sign is interpreted as energy you carry but struggle to express outwardly — like a room in your house with no door. It shows up in blind spots, talents you can't quite unlock, and patterns that repeat without explanation. Pull up your chart. Is there a sign tucked inside a house with no cusp?

candidates.video_description: Neptune is currently retrograde at 2.3° Aries — a sign it hasn't occupied since the 1860s. In astrology, Neptune dissolves boundaries while Aries charges forward, creating a paradox. Retrograde intensifies the internal, disorienting dimension of this transit.
candidates.script: Neptune is retrograde right now at 2 degrees Aries — a placement this planet hasn't held since the 1860s. That's not a small thing. In astrology, Neptune dissolves whatever it touches, blurs reality, and rules collective illusion — and Aries is the sign of individual identity and raw initiative. That combination, in retrograde, is interpreted as a generation quietly losing and then rebuilding its sense of self. The last time this happened, the world was being reshaped at its foundations. Sound familiar?
